title: Reel two begins: Max Fink and New Orleans violinists
summary: Allen resumes on the second reel and asks about Max Fink; Kelly describes him as a violinist in New Orleans theaters and carnival balls, and mentions Ted Frank.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Well, this is Tim Kelly again, the second reel. And we got to talking about Kelly and how the great musicians were attracted, you were saying. And I never didn't know anything about Max Fink, at least I didn't remember. Well, he was

before your time. He was a violinist and a very extremely popular character in New Orleans history. Played in the theaters and played for all the carnival balls and things like that. Well, Ted Frank, yes. I loved Ted Frank and I knew his father before him. And Dave who established the sheet meat business at Welland.
